title: The Sanitary Tee Horizontal Mistake
description: Using a standard sanitary tee in a horizontal waste line is a very common plumbing mistake. Sanitary tees feature a short radius sweep designed primarily for transitioning flow from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. When installed horizontally, the short directional change causes flow velocity to drop and prevents waste solids from moving efficiently along the pipe. Over time, this restriction leads to recurring blockages and sluggish drainage. For horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe connections, always use a combination wye and 1/8 bend fitting or a long-turn fitting to maintain proper flow velocity and prevent clogs.
